nodes.name: IF: Rattle deal alert
nodes.notes: Rattle bot user = U05AA8MBV9B. Also requires a *Name:* line, which drops edited/deleted/non-deal messages (their top-level text is empty).

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Type, AccountId, Account.Name, Owner.Name, Shop_ID__c, Start_Date__c, DocuSign_End_Date__c, Opt_Out__c, Opt_Out_Date__c, Minimum_Spend__c, CloseDate, Closed_Won_Reason__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Name = '{{ $json.soql_name }}' AND (StageName = 'Closed Won' OR StageName LIKE '5%' OR StageName = 'Pricing & Negotiations') ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 1

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =SELECT Product2.Name, Package_Type__c, Platform_Fee__c, Number_Of_Months__c, UnitPrice FROM OpportunityLineItem WHERE OpportunityId = '{{ $json.records[0].Id }}'

nodes.name: SF: Line Items
nodes.notes: Uses the Opp Id from the previous node. Product2.Name is a relationship field -> records[].Product2.Name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =SELECT Name, Status__c, SpotDraft_ID__c, Date_Contract_Completed__c, CreatedDate FROM SpotDraft_Contract__c WHERE Account__c = '{{ $('SF: Opportunity').item.json.records[0].AccountId }}' ORDER BY Date_Contract_Completed__c DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

nodes.name: SF: Contracts
nodes.notes: Custom object SpotDraft_Contract__c. Newest completed SO first so the worker picks the governing contract.

nodes.name: Call audit worker
nodes.notes: Worker runs the 16-check audit (SpotDraft + Claude + SKILL.md), posts the result in-thread and adds the white_check_mark reaction itself. No Slack node needed downstream.
